caption: The drawing features a series of decorative and geometric patterns arranged in horizontal bands, rendered primarily in red, pink, green, black, and gray. At the top, there is a thin horizontal red stripe with a faint black line above it. Below this, a botanical motif displays two flowers, one large and red with a black center, and one smaller and pink, with dark green leaves and brown stems. To the right, there is a single, dark brown, half-open seed pod and a leaf outlined in pencil. Further down, there is an intricate geometric pattern in green and peach, with right-angled shapes and a bold peach vertical stripe bordered in black, with a thin green rectangle as the background. Next to this is a black-outlined circle divided into arc segments. Below, two peaches with green leaves are illustrated, painted in light and dark red with black outlines, followed by another horizontal band: a thin red stripe with a wider black strip beneath. There are pencil annotations around the objects and sketch lines outlining design elements and providing notes on colors and dimensions. The entire drawing is on a cream-colored background, with some areas left unfinished or only outlined in pencil. Blue pencil marks provide measurements, specifically indicating a length of 36 1/2 inches and a height of 22 1/2 inches.
title: Wall Painting
